raise_ApiError: raise an ApiError with a custom message, HTTP status code, and error code string
raise_ExternalAuthenticatedError: raise an ExternalAuthenticatedError to return 404 when an authenticated user fails the external auth check
raise_ExternalUnauthenticatedError: raise an ExternalUnauthenticatedError to return 401 when an unauthenticated user fails the external auth check
raise_JWTExpiredSignature: raise a JWTExpiredSignature error to return 401 when a JWT token has expired
raise_UnexpectedApiError: raise an UnexpectedApiError to log and return 500 when the server encounters an unexpected error
